The AUSTIN CHARTERS Winter fishing package is just as exciting! For only $450, you’ll enjoy a 4-hour adventure for up to 4 people. We provide everything you need to have a comfortable and enjoyable experience on the ice, including heated shelter, ATV transportation, and all the necessary equipment and bait.
